name: Plus Morph
summary: A tab bar whose plus button stretches into an add-expense panel, then folds into a check as the spend lands
about: A money app with a floating tab bar and a round plus button sitting in its notch. Tap it and the button squashes, then stretches up like soft paint into a full add-expense panel while the notch flattens and the tabs sink. Type an amount on the keypad, pick a category and save: the panel folds back into the button, which spins, turns into a green check, and sends a receipt flying into your recent list while the PKR left this month rolls down.
how: Tap the plus button in the middle of the tab bar to grow the panel; tap the cross to fold it away.
Type the amount with the keypad (or the number keys on a keyboard) and choose a category such as Food, Fuel or Bills.
Press Save expense: the panel shrinks into a check, the new spend drops into Recent and the budget meter updates.
Use the tabs to see this week's bars, your budgets by category and your settings, all worked out from the same spending.
Keyboard: Enter saves, Backspace deletes a digit, Escape closes and the arrow keys move between tabs.
